header.sector: Optical interconnects, transceivers and datacenter networking
header.title: Merger threatens Chinese optical module makers' access to critical laser and DSP inputs

s01_bottom_line.text: Chinese optical module makers are leading suppliers of 800G and 1.6T transceivers but rely heavily on Marvell DSPs and Lumentum EML/CW laser sources; the merger plus Lumentum's ownership of Cloud Light raises the risk their input access is restricted.
TrendForce expects the competitive threat to Chinese optical module suppliers to be central to China's regulatory review, implying this could gate or condition the deal.
A combined Marvell-Lumentum could disadvantage Chinese transceiver makers dependent on its inputs; the article does not name specific listed Chinese suppliers or quantify the revenue impact.
